text:
Ashley K: hey team — running a region sweep for llama-2-13b, mistral-7b, and qwen-7b-v2 (nf4/int8) across us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. seeing a weird latency bump for qwen on h100s in eu-west-1 around seq_len=2048. anyone seen this?

Mike R: yep saw that earlier. looks like runtime fell back to rope-legacy kernel for qwen when sequence distribution has >15% >=2048. fallback logs in the node show 'kernel_select: rope-fallback -> rope-legacy (incompat)'.

Sara V: logs show GQA warn too: `GQA: expected gqa-v2, got gqa-compat` for those models. stacktrace points to kernel matcher failing on kv_cache alignment.

Lee H: quick repro command I ran: 
```
./bench --model qwen-7b-v2 --region eu-west-1 --gpu h100 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --quant nf4 --profile
```
output: 
```
P50: 72ms P95: 210ms P99: 480ms  (rope-legacy)
same run with kernel pin to gqa-v2:
P50: 38ms P95: 65ms P99: 120ms (gqa-v2)
```

Priya N: I think kv cache warmup + prefix-caching policy differences make the matcher choose legacy kernel because it doesn't detect aligned strides. first-token spikes on cold cache. also saw a small regression on A100-80GB but not as bad.

Ashley K: so region-specific because eu-west-1 pool has mixed H100 firmware sets and a different driver (470.x vs 510.x)? that could alter kernel heuristics.

Mike R: exactly. driver + cudnn minors can flip the kernel selection table. I reproduced on a local h100 with older driver and saw fallback.

Sara V: suggested short-term: add explicit kernel pin for qwen-7b-v2 to gqa-v2 in the model profile for eu-west-1, and add a metric that counts kernel_fallback events. long-term: make matcher aware of kv-cache stride tolerance.

Lee H: I pushed a patch to the model catalog: `kernel_hint: gqa-v2` for qwen-7b-v2 in eu-west-1 reserved pools. deployed to canary.

deploy-bot: deploy: catalog:kernel-hint-qwen-v2 -> canary started by Lee H (sha: b4c3def).

infra-bot: canary health: 10/10 nodes OK. no OOMs.

Mike R: rerun of the benchmark after canary applied: 
```
region eu-west-1 h100 (canary): P50 40ms P95 68ms P99 130ms
us-west-2 a100-80gb: P50 36ms P95 60ms P99 110ms
ap-southeast-1 h100 (old-driver): P50 70ms P95 220ms P99 450ms
```

Priya N: actionable: reserve extra burst capacity in eu-west-1 h100 pool for next 48h, add kernel_fallback alert (count >5/hour), and schedule a firmware/driver harmonization sweep with infra.

Ashley K: cool — next steps: 1) keep kernel pin for qwen canary for 24h, 2) add fallback metric & dashboard (Sara), 3) infra to plan driver sync (Priya + infra), 4) run full seq_len sweep including 4096/8192 to validate rope edge cases (Mike). I'll follow up with an RFC if any further platform changes needed. :thumbsup:
